Generally, two types of questions are asked in this chapter. TYPE - 1 In this type of question some groups of objects are given and some diagrams are given. Through those diagrams one has to find that diagram which correctly classifies the group of objects in the given question. Let us understand these types of questions with the following example. Ex- 1 Mango, potato, Book Sol: Looking at the above group, it is unclear that there is no mutual relationship among the three. Therefore, all three have been drawn differently. Ex-2 India, Bihar, Patna Sol: It is clear here that Patna is part of Bihar and Bihar is part of India. Hence the diagram is drawn as above. Ex-3 Mango, Apple, Fruit Sol: It is clear that Apple and Mango are two different things, but both are the types of fruits, so they are shown above. Ex-4 Woman, Mother, Sister Sol: It is clear that some mothers may be sisters and some sisters may also be mothers. Therefore the relation of mother and sister will be drawn from small circles and since mother and sister are women, the diagram will be shown from the above diagram. Ex-5 Domestic animal, Dog, Cat It is clear that some dogs and some cats are pets, but not all pets are dogs and cats. And dogs and cats are not related to each other, so the above question will be shown from this diagram. Ex-6 Parents, Rich person, Farmers Sol:- It is clear that some parents can be rich and farmers too. Similarly, rich people can also be parents and farmers. Similarly, farmers can also be rich and parents. Hence: we will draw these three from this diagram. Ex-7 Vegetable, Tomato, Orange Sol:- It is clear here that tomato is a type of vegetable. The relation of these two is shown by making two circles. But the orange class is completely different from both. Therefore it is drawn differently. Ex-8 Snake, Reptiles, Poisonous It is clear here that all snakes are reptiles. It is drawn by drawing two circles. But some snakes are also poisonous. Therefore, the person representing the poisons will be connected to these two circles. Hence the diagram will be drawn as above. Ex-9 Woman, Mother, Baby girl Sol: It is clear that all mothers are women. It is drawn by drawing two circles. Some women can also be children. But no child can be a mother. Ex-10 Fathers , Uncles , Aunts Sol: It is clear that some fathers can also be uncles and some uncles can also be fathers. But the class of aunt is completely different from these two. Hence: The diagram will be drawn as above. TYPE-II In this type of question, a joint figure is attached to each other.
